name: code-review
description: Comprehensive code review workflow: branch reviews, PR triage, false positive dismissal, and fix tracking

coverage_threshold.title: Coverage threshold (%)
coverage_threshold.description: Target used by /code-review:coverage-gate when CI configures no threshold for a category. Leave empty to keep the built-in defaults (55% all, 80% new, 65% modified) and to stop when CI has no coverage config at all.

base_branch.title: Default base branch
base_branch.description: Base branch for /code-review:coverage-gate when none is passed as an argument. Leave empty to detect it from origin/HEAD.
